newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania central bank 1995 profit down to 760.5 bln lei.
newsitem.headline: Romania central bank 1995 profit down to 760.5 bln lei.

text.p: The National Bank of Romania (BNR) said on Monday its gross profit slipped to 760.5 billion lei last year from 993.7 billion lei in 1994.
The bank's total balance sheet rose by 25.4 percent to 15.1 trillion lei at end-1995, reflecting a re-evaluation of claims and liablities and of the BNR's funds, the annual report said.

Refinancing accounted for 24.6 percent of the 1995 total balance sheet, up from 19.5 percent in 1994, showing that the banking system relied to a large extent on the central bank's monetary creation, the report said.
It said the BNR's own funds were 277 billion lei at end-1995, or 16.9-percent higher than in 1994.
Around 23 percent of the bank's 1995 profit went to increase reserves and other funds, while profit tax amounted to 580 billion lei.
The BNR's 1995 income, which was some 95 percent derived from interest on refinancing loans, fell by 2.2 percent from 1994 to 1.53 trillion lei.

Spending was 771.5 billion lei, up 34.9 percent on 1994. Interest and commisions paid accounted for about 38 percent of total spending, while support to subsidise credits for farmers and energy sector took some 30 percent, the report said.
Year-on-year inflation was cut to 27.8 percent last year from 61.7 percent in 1994. It is now running at 45.3 percent.
